authoredBy: fresh independent review v17, BEFORE any command execution
grounding: Each expectation is derived from my own verification of the frozen bytes and the 1308 transitive source pins, not from the candidate's recorded logs. The frozen logs are compared against AFTER execution, never used to author the expectation.

expectations.claim: All six reference-check commands exit 0 in a byte-exact disposable full copy.
expectations.basis: Every command source matches its declared sourceSha256 AND the manifest entry; all 1308 transitive pins (foundation 1099, native 71, security 73, workflows 65) match the frozen bytes. A pin-refusing checker therefore has no reason to refuse.
expectations.falsifiable: Any non-zero exit is a finding, not something to repair by repinning.

expectations.claim: Each check REGENERATES its in-tree report byte-identically to the frozen one.
expectations.basis: The checks are declared deterministic over pinned inputs. If a regenerated report differs from the frozen report, then the frozen report is not reproducible from the frozen sources.

expectations.claim: The native checker writes its report in-tree, so it must be run ONLY inside a disposable copy.
expectations.basis: Declared in the reference-checks record and in the prior review; running it in the frozen snapshot or live repo would mutate an immutable artifact.

expectations.claim: After execution, the copy's delta versus the manifest is confined to regenerated report files; no source file is modified.
expectations.basis: A check that rewrites its own pinned source would invalidate the pin model.

expectations.claim: The frozen snapshot verifies identically AFTER the review as before (7671/7671, 0 undeclared).
expectations.basis: Nothing in this review may write to the snapshot.

expectations.claim: The headline counts in technical-review.v17.md are reproducible from the EXECUTED reports, and are measured calls / distinct IDs / scoped cases and sweeps, not product qualification.
expectations.falsifiable: Any headline number I cannot re-derive from an executed report is reported as unverified, not restated.

rulesBoundOnMyself: No pin is ever rewritten, under any circumstance.
No source byte in any copy is edited to make a check pass.
Every failed attempt is preserved with its corrected successor.
Positive controls must be full admitted Run graphs where the change affects closure; schema fragments do not prove full Runs.
A copied boolean alone never proves authorization.
